mapper.select: select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/
t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日期**/ t.TRADE_AMT bonusAmt,/**分红金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNo,/**资金账户**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt/**结算金额**/
t.TRADE_DATE tradeDateReInvest,/**交易日期**/ t.PRIN_AMT bonusAmtReInvest,/**分红金额**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNumReInvest,/**交易份额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE unitBonusUnitValue,/**单位净值**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmtReInvest,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNoReInvest/**资金账户**/
t.TRADE_DATE tradeDateStrengthen,/**交易日期**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNumStrengthen,/**交易份额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNoStrengthen/**资金账户**/
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = SUBSTR(t.finprod_id,5,LENGTH(t.finprod_id)) LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in( '06','07') LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE in( '06','07') and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
